# sprint update

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../README.md) · [Parent](../README.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint update — update the installed Sprint CLI.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint update [--yes | -y | --no | -n] [--non-interactive]

DESCRIPTION
  Check the latest stable version. Manual updates ask y/n (default n).
  The existing installation prefix is preserved; source checkouts are not updated.

EXAMPLES
  sprint update
  sprint update --yes --non-interactive
  sprint update --no

FLAGS
  --yes, -y          Install without a confirmation prompt.
  --no, -n           Cancel without contacting npm.
  --non-interactive  Require explicit --yes or --no.

OUTPUT
  JSON on stdout: current, cancelled or updated status. Errors on stderr, exit 1.

NOTES
  Set SPRINT_AUTO_UPDATE=0 to disable automatic startup updates.
  Automatic updates run for interactive business invocations; help, version,
  schemas, MCP and automation do not update on startup.

SEE ALSO
  sprint help
  sprint topic automation
```
